indicator_name: Foreign Demand Index: export-weighted partner real GDP growth
description: Индекс внешнего спроса: рост реального ВВП партнёров, взвешенный по экспорту
methodology: Index, same quarter of the previous year = 100: real GDP growth of Kazakhstan's main export partners weighted by their 2023-2025 export shares (euro area 58.8%, China 25.4%, Russia 15.9%; BNS indicator 312101, reviewed 2026-09-25). Built from EA_GDP_REAL, CN_GDP_REAL_YOY and RU_GDP_REAL for the quarters all three cover (from 2015-Q1).
